description: This file defines the `AesStreamInterface` interface within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically in the Crypto namespace. It extends the `StreamInterface` from PSR-7 and declares methods for retrieving AES encryption details such as the OpenSSL cipher name, AES name, and the initialization vector (IV).

classes.name: AesStreamInterface
classes.description: Interface for AES stream operations, extending PSR-7's StreamInterface and providing methods to get encryption parameters.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher name identifier, such as 'aes-256-cbc'.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable AES cipher name, such as 'AES/GCM/NoPadding'.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the current initialization vector (IV) used for encryption or decryption.
